updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.2.13 
- New F10 menu processing routine and error handling - mitigate large server F10 menu errors Foothold etc.
- Ignore larger F10 menus that exceed chunk limits, revert previous F10 handling changes.
- Remove all Pro licensing code and artwork F-14 Jockeys test AIRIO please.
- Major Update to add F-4E Phantom II Jester 2.0 - testers see Discord for how to setup your Voice Attack Profile.
- Fixes broken F10 message construction.
- remove WSO Cache messages from Voice Attack log and build seperate cache .json log.
- Move divert commands to WSO.vap so all variable cache based commands have multipart key phrases.
- Add ICS Hot Mic for F-4E in Hot Mic or Override uses the same proceadure as F-14.
- add support for WSO tuning radio to ATC and Pave Spike Readt and Standby commands.
- fix broken export for WSO revipients.
- Adds support for TACAN channels and stations for f-4E WSO.
- Add ICS Hot Mic for AH-64D Apache Works on Hot Mic or VOX.
- Fixes for CTD when payload empty F-4E WSO.
- Adds OpenKneeboard Out V1.0 Web Console.
- Fix Open Kneeboard Autobrowse bugs.
- Fix AH-64D Hot Mic not working with Hold AI Transmissions selected in MP tab.
- Support Jester 2.0 TACAN tuning of Assets, Tankers, Carriers, etc. 
- Add OpenKneeboard Out enhancments, METAR, TACAN, BRA, Tanker Type and formatting changes for Standard Kneeboard 
- Open Kneeboad Out MATAR wind gradients for High eleveation airports. 
- OpenKneeboard out Increase Font sizes. 
- Open Kneeboard Doodles Only Mode for Notes Tab. 
- Filter Closest Airport selection based on Aircraft type Fixed Wing/Rotary effects No longer calling FARPS and Heli bases in Fixed wing. 
- Better TACAN and Data for AWACS and Flight if so configured. 
- Adds additional F-4E WSO Logging. 
- Add OpenKneeboard OUT Datalink threats if AWACS is available WIP (Excludes Player and Clients on MP Servers). OpenKneeboard OUT bug fixes for METAR output and US/ICAO switching. 
- Add F-14 Pilot and RIO connection monitor on Vaicom UI. 
- F-4E Jester 2.0 support Divert to Airfield/Assets. 
- Fix Options closing with TXLink PTT. 
- Fix Jester Options not exiting cleanly after command completion, no long requires PTT press. 
- Fix Multiplaye detection bug when server has pre loaded aircarft frequencies or DTC's. 
- Fix Crash of Voice Attack when open vaicom UI while in F-4E. 
- Fix ICS listening state on all TX Nodes. 
- Fix E-2D not recognised as AWCACS on Kneeboard, added E-7A as AEWACS. 
- Adds Jester INS Alignment Commands 
- Remove export developmentlogging. 
- Hot Mic logging and TX-1-4 and TXLink fixes V2. WSO Command database renumbering. 
-Hide F-4E contect dialog but retain Jester wheel if needed.
- New Jester Contect Dialog code fix Alignment issues 
- New OpenKneeboard OUT Plugin generation for OpenKneeboard.
- Resizing and saved state Open Kneeboard windows and minor enhancements.
- New WSO export handling for aliases. 
- Fix F-14 Jester wheel not showing due appeneded file not writing. 
- Allow Menu commands to be passed in Hot Mic mode active. 
- Add Special commands to OpenKneeboard Out F-4E Keywords. 
- Fix hopefully TXlink and menu handling. 
- Adds F-4E Pilot/WSO display logic. 
- Combine F-4E WSO Divert to commands Airfield and Asset. 
- Add F-100D Super Sabre as supported module. 
- Fix AH-64 Hotmic filtering George commands incorrectly. 
- Add Pave Spike Lock/Unlock commands WSO F-4E 
- reinstate old Jester mini wheel. 
- Add New Keywords system to help tab, includes plugin generation for OpenKneeboard with browse controls.
